tasks.short: Instruct students with lectures, discussions, and demonstrations.

steps.what: Read pupil names and the group from the pupil record.
Instruct students individually and in groups using lectures.
Hold discussions as one of the various teaching methods.
Give demonstrations of those teaching methods.

tasks.design: She instructs students in the room with lectures, discussions, and demonstrations. A configured read on the pupil record ({OTHER}) shows pupil name and group, and stays empty when those fields are blank. No lesson is drafted, nothing is sent, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Who is in the group sits in a record she opens by hand, and the teaching itself cannot be prepared in advance of the room.
tasks.enabler_now: The pupil record can show name and group when those fields are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Lectures, discussions, and demonstrations still depend on the pupils in front of her.
tasks.human_edge: She instructs. The name list does not choose the method or give the demonstration.
tasks.altitude: She still instructs every group with lectures, discussions, and demonstrations. The name list does not give her a right to skip a method.

reach.task: Lay out the pieces she will demonstrate.
reach.learn: Which demonstration she has already chosen, so the assistant does not pick the teaching method.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: lectures, discussions, and demonstrations are the bulk of this task. A name-and-group read is the small screen slice.
Annex III point 3 treats AI that admits pupils, evaluates learning outcomes, sets the education level, or watches tests as high-risk.
WOR does not apply to schools. Under the WMS, staff consent to tools that can monitor them, and parents and pupils consent to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: The school office stores pupil name and group code on the pupil record before the lesson, outside this task. That capture is not counted as saved. The fields are pupil name and group code only. If either is blank, the read returns nothing and she instructs the people in the room. She does not treat a blank as an absence.
The read does not store a teaching method, a mark, or a health note. Lectures, discussions, and demonstrations stay at full time.
No lesson is drafted. No message is sent to a pupil, a parent, or a colleague. No alert is raised. The record does not log her hours or her speed.
The 0.2 hour allowance is only correcting a stale group code. It is not teaching time.
unknowns: Whether pupil name and group code are already on the pupil record before the lesson.
Whether she may open that pupil record herself.
research_questions: Which of pupil name and group code is already stored on the pupil record before the lesson, and who may edit them?

incremental.description: Correct a stale group code when a pupil joins after the list was stored.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a lesson where pupil name or group code is blank, so the read saves nothing and she instructs the room. High is 1, only the name-and-group read. Lectures, discussions, and demonstrations stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish behavior rules and enforce them among students.

steps.what: Establish behavior rules and procedures for maintaining order.
Enforce those rules among students in the workshop.
File workshop rule v1 in the document store.
Check workshop rule v1 states those behavior rules.

tasks.design: She establishes the behavior rules and enforces them among students in the room. A separate step files workshop rule v1 in the {DOCS}, and she checks that version against the rules she named. The rule is not sent to pupils, parents, or colleagues, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The rule only exists after she has established it, so a form cannot write the procedure first.
tasks.enabler_now: A document app can store the rules she has already named, in her own words.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping order among students is still her judgement in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: She establishes the rules and enforces them. The file does not sanction a pupil.
tasks.altitude: She still sets the rules and still enforces them in the workshop. Filing workshop rule v1 does not give her a right to sanction a pupil from the document.

reach.task: Say which behavior rule must stay individual for a pupil with support needs.
reach.learn: Which rule is a support arrangement, so workshop rule v1 does not turn it into a general sanction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: establishing rules and enforcing order among students are the bulk of this task. Filing the rule she has already named is the small slice.
WOR does not apply to schools. Under the WMS, staff consent to tools that can monitor them, and parents and pupils consent to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: She establishes the behavior rules and the procedures herself, at full time, before any file. Workshop rule v1 is only those words. She then checks that version states the rules she named. A later change voids the file.

Enforcing order among students stays in the room at full time. The file is not a send. It is not mailed to pupils, parents, or colleagues. No behaviour alert is raised, and the file writes no sanction.
The document store does not log her hours or her speed. WOR does not apply. Staff consent under the WMS applies if the store can monitor staff.
The 0.3 hour allowance is correcting workshop rule v1 when the filed words are not the rules she named. It is not time spent keeping order.
unknowns: Whether behavior rules are already a signed school policy she may only enforce.
Whether a workshop rule is kept in the document store today.
research_questions: Is a workshop behavior rule already a signed school policy, or does she write the words herself?

incremental.description: Correct workshop rule v1 when the filed words are not the behavior rules she named.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week where she keeps the rules in her head and files nothing. High is 2, only filing workshop rule v1 after she has established the rules and then checking that version. Enforcing order among students stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe and evaluate performance, behavior, development, and health.

steps.what: Read pupil names for this group from the pupil record.
Observe students' performance and behavior in the shop.
Evaluate social development from what she observed.
Watch physical health while she evaluates those students.

tasks.design: She observes and evaluates performance, behavior, social development, and physical health herself. A configured read on the pupil record ({OTHER}) shows pupil name and group only. No score, emotion label, or health diagnosis is written, nothing is sent, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: What she sees in the room is not a field, and a health or behavior score would be the wrong record.
tasks.enabler_now: The pupil record can show who is in the group when name and group are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating performance, behavior, social development, and physical health stays with her, and a wrong label can harm a pupil.
tasks.human_edge: She observes and evaluates. The name list does not score, diagnose, or infer emotion.
tasks.altitude: She still observes and still evaluates every pupil herself. She does not gain a right to store a score, a level, or a health diagnosis.

reach.task: Tell her which pupil already has a known support arrangement.
reach.learn: Which support arrangement is already agreed, so she does not write a health diagnosis from what she sees.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: observing and evaluating performance, behavior, social development, and physical health is her judgement in the room. A name list is the small screen slice.
Annex III point 3 treats AI that admits pupils, evaluates learning outcomes, sets the education level, or watches tests as high-risk.
Inferring pupils' emotions is a prohibited AI practice.
Model knowledge: a pupil's physical health, if written into a record, is health data under GDPR article 9, and a new pupil-data system needs a DPIA under article 35.

assumptions: The school office stores pupil name and group code on the pupil record before the class, outside this task. That capture is not counted as saved. No performance mark, behavior score, social label, or health field is read or written. If the name is blank, she observes the room without the list.
She observes and evaluates herself, at full time. Nothing in this task scores an outcome, sets an education level, watches a test, infers emotion, or stores a physical-health diagnosis.
No message is sent to a parent, a pupil, or a colleague. No alert is raised. The read does not log her hours or her speed.
The 0.2 hour allowance is confirming a newly joined pupil's name on the list. It is not the evaluation.
unknowns: Whether the pupil record already has a health or behavior field she is expected to fill.
Whether what she sees of physical health is written down anywhere today.
research_questions: Does the pupil record have a health or behavior field, and is she required to write in it?

incremental.description: Confirm a newly joined pupil's name when the stored group list is missing that name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a class where the name list is blank, so she observes everyone without it. High is 1, only the name-and-group read. Observing and evaluating performance, behavior, social development, and physical health stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct occupation skills with a plan and shop studies.

steps.what: Name the knowledge and skills required in this specific occupational field.
Set the systematic plan for this occupation.
File occupation plan v1 in the document store.
Check occupation plan v1 names those occupation skills.
Instruct students using lectures, discussions, and audio-visual presentations.
Run laboratory, shop, and field studies with those students.

tasks.design: She names the occupation skills and the systematic plan, then instructs with lectures, discussions, audio-visual presentations, and laboratory, shop, and field studies. A separate step files occupation plan v1 in the {DOCS}, and she checks that version names those skills. The plan is not sent, no model drafts it, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The systematic plan only exists after she has named the skills, so a file cannot be written first, and the shop lesson cannot be given by the file.
tasks.enabler_now: A document app can store the plan she has already set, in her own words.
tasks.still_hard: Instructing in the laboratory, the shop, and the field still depends on the pupils and the tools in front of her.
tasks.human_edge: She names the skills, sets the plan, and instructs. The file does not teach the occupation.
tasks.altitude: She still names the skills, still sets the plan, and still instructs in the shop. The file does not give her a right to send the plan or to grade the pupil.

reach.task: Keep the occupation skill list for this programme.
reach.learn: Which skills are already fixed, so occupation plan v1 does not drop or invent one.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: instructing the occupation in the room is the bulk of this task. Filing a plan she has already set is the small slice.
Annex III point 3 treats AI that admits pupils, evaluates learning outcomes, sets the education level, or watches tests as high-risk.
WOR does not apply to schools. Under the WMS, staff consent to tools that can monitor them, and parents and pupils consent to pupil-data rules.

assumptions: She names the knowledge and skills and sets the systematic plan herself, at full time, before occupation plan v1 exists. The file stores only that plan. She checks that the version names those skills. A later change voids the file.
Lectures, discussions, audio-visual presentations, and laboratory, shop, and field studies stay at full time. The plan is not emailed and not posted. No model writes it. No grade is stored.
The document store does not log her hours or her speed. WOR does not apply. Staff consent under the WMS applies if the store can monitor staff.
The 0.3 hour allowance is correcting occupation plan v1 when a required skill is missing from the filed words. It is not teaching time.
unknowns: Whether a systematic plan for this occupation already exists as a school document.
Whether laboratory and field studies are logged anywhere today.
research_questions: Which occupation skills are already fixed by the programme, and which does she still name in the plan?

incremental.description: Correct occupation plan v1 when a required skill is missing from the filed words.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a day where she teaches from memory and files no plan. High is 2, only filing occupation plan v1 after she has named the skills and set the plan, then checking that version. Lectures, discussions, presentations, and shop studies stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still instructs, still keeps order in the workshop, and still observes and evaluates pupils herself. Two short files record a rule and a plan she has already set. She does not gain a right to score a pupil, to infer health, or to send a note out.
reach: special education teacher: which behavior rule must stay individual when a pupil has support needs, so workshop rule v1 does not become a sanction
instructional coordinator: which occupation skills the systematic plan must still name, so occupation plan v1 does not drop a required skill
teaching assistant: which demonstration or shop setup the assistant may prepare, while the workshop teacher still instructs
skills_to_grow: Refuse a model draft of a lecture, a demonstration, or the occupation plan.
Refuse a mark, a level, an emotion label, or a health diagnosis on a pupil.
Refuse a parent message, a behaviour alert, or a report send from these tasks.
role.ambitious_version: The same teacher still instructs the class, enforces order in the room, and evaluates what she sees. The files only store the rule and the plan she has already set.
